facts.fact: The UN Committee on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities says Mauritius's Protection and Promotion of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act of 2024 does not cover the right to information in an accessible format, with only limited measures to promote accessible printed and electronic information, and recommends that it establish accessibility standards for information, communication technologies and websites.
